headline: Brazil producer prices rise 0.98% in October led by food and oil refining
summary: Brazilian mine and factory prices rose 0.98% in October, marking the second consecutive month above 0.9%, driven by increases in food and oil refining costs.
why: Producer price inflation serves as an early indicator for consumer price pressures and informs central bank monetary policy decisions.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Higher industrial prices reflect growing production input costs across the domestic economy.
